text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takarazuka Kinen, I was waiting 
in the prep room with Kawakami Princess, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Staying true to your own way of life 
really is what makes someone so cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"No, for real, your declaration at the Fan 
Thanksgiving gave me absolute chills! It 
really helped me make up my mind, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(She is Vodka. A Classic-class Umamusume 
this year who switched paths midway from 
the Tiara route to the Triple Crown route 
and won the Derby.)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, you're right! Sorry for overstaying 
my welcome!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Today, for the sake of my own brand of 
cool, I'm gonna repay you, Senpai... No, 
I'm gonna challenge you! Let's do this!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: H-Hwawawawa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, an Umamusume a generation younger 
than Kawakami Princess, has also announced 
her entry into this Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is a Grand Prix where 
Senior and Classic Umamusume clash. 
However, a Classic Umamusume winning the 
race is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I am getting fired up!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This development! A new star taking on a 
challenge widely considered 
impossible—it's just like episode 35 of 
"Precure☆Returns"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's a legendary episode where the old and 
new protagonists clash! Facing off against 
the legendary princess revived as a shadow 
puts them in a truly desperate situation.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"However, the new protagonist never gives 
up and fights back! And as a result...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is, of course, the current 
protagonist's—...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh-wha!? In this race, it is I, the 
princess, who shall win, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I am no shadow! I will claim 
victory for my own sake!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was full of spirit. 
However, in this Takarazuka Kinen, it 
wasn't just her juniors waiting for her—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“—Are you prepared to be thoroughly 
beaten? Kawakami-san.”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
K-K-King-san!? Can things even turn out 
like this?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot surrender today's 
victory. No matter who my opponent is, I 
will knock them down and climb to the very 
top!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Muuuuurrrgh!! King-san, we'll settle the 
rest in the paddock!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...You sure were raring to go, weren't 
you? Fufu, what was—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Children grow up so fast, don't they?
choice_data_list: You're just a kid too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, who do you think you're talking to? 
I'm not a child, I am the King.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Vodka-san. You're a hundred 
years too early to challenge me, you 
know...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S-Senpai... You kind of sound like a 
villain just now, though...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but this is simply who I am.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us show each other our paths. For 
this race belongs to no one else but us!
